observations.scope_limit: Captured replies include shared kernel traffic; no sole-actor race attribution or decoded-motion inference.

summaries.semantic_outcome: Cemu 29f2f1f ARM64 AppImage, motionplus-nunchuk, without an external kernel MP holder, reads base EEPROM at 0x0016 successfully with the synthetic caller image. The native sequence identifies Nunchuk then sends 18 register-space reads at A40020 for 16 bytes, receiving 18 error 7 responses. This confirms the downstream calibration boundary, not MotionPlus calibration. Decoded application motion is unobserved. No defaults, physical calibration or radio acceptance is inferred.
